IGUI_MapOption_Isometric_tooltip: On: the map turns to match the game view, with north at the top right. Off: top-down, north up. The map has only these two directions; it does not rotate with your character.
IGUI_MapOption_RemoteSymbols_tooltip: Off hides every map symbol other players share; yours stay. To hide only certain players, pick them in the "Remote Symbols" category of Map Display Settings, or right-click their symbol on the world map.
